svg.title: Gated scan and Survey Touch workflow
svg.desc: Original process schematic. Hardware and firmware gates precede motor checks and scan calibration. Scanning handles homing, gantry leveling and mesh. Clean-nozzle Survey Touch follows leveling.

g.text: Original process schematic • all physical actions require closed gates and supervision
E1 boards • E4 probe cable • E5 generation • E6 square/motion • E7 bed/magnet/geometry
Embedded magnets block this scan path; heater operations separately require E2/E3
Scan Z home → QGL → Z home
CARTOGRAPHER_TOUCH_HOME after leveling and cleaning → approved final heat-up → first print
No automatic brush coordinates; no touch-mesh workaround; measured models only
A successful documentation build is not physical validation of mechanics, firmware, safety or probing.
